info.schedule: Online, usually a minimum-bid round in July or August and a no-reserve round in the fall

There is a shallow ditch that runs along the Newburgh Road property line. Property measures approximately 317 feet of frontage on Sumter Road and 275 foot of frontage on Newburgh. Nice quiet country community, Great place for a house!
